info.name: JDT17 WMS API - Full Test Suite
info.description:
Wealth Management System — Complete Postman test collection.
Covers Auth, User (me), Assets, Goals, Risk Profiler, Products, Admin, and Dashboard.

Setup:
1. Set baseUrl variable to http://localhost:8080
2. Run 'Login - Success' first to auto-save the accessToken
3. Then run other folders in order
